title: Progressive multi-region swap with LTS-channel routing and surge-control
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Harden the Hosted API pipeline so we can perform cross-region swaps without customer-visible regressions while respecting LTS channel pins and minimizing unit cost. This work implements a progressive multi-region switch that: 1) pins traffic for LTS customers to their selected channel until explicit opt-in, 2) ramps new regions with adaptive flow-control based on error-rate and latency SLOs, 3) warms KV caches and kernel-selection metrics before full cutover, and 4) exposes operator-visible holdpoints and automatic rollback heuristics.
acceptance_criteria: Can perform a controlled region swap where 0->100% region cutover completes within configured ramp windows and obeys canary/warmup steps
LTS-tagged customer traffic remains pinned to their chosen model variant unless explicitly migrated
Automatic rollback triggers on sustained SLO violation (p50/p99 latency and error budget burn) and circuit-breaker engages within defined thresholds
Metric dashboards show reduced cold-start token cost by at least 18% for warmed paths compared to baseline on previous regional swaps
End-to-end integration tests cover routing policies, KV warmup, and simulated regional outage fallback
design_notes: We are extending the routing plane to support: a) explicit channel pins (lts:v1, lts:v2) on auth tokens; b) staged warming windows that pre-populate KV caches for a sampled subset of requests; c) a ramp controller that uses adaptive delta increments instead of fixed percentages when error budget is low. Implementation will live in platform/router and runtime-ops. We chose a conservative default ramp (5% every 10 minutes) with exponential backoff if errors exceed threshold. Rollback is asynchronous: first reduce traffic to previous region, then revoke routing changes once healthy metrics stabilise for 15 consecutive minutes.
implementation_steps: Add LTS-channel metadata to identity tokens (auth service) and expose routing predicate
Implement KV prewarm path and a sampled-warmup flag in the gateway
Build ramp controller service with policy engine (rate, max_inflight, error thresholds)
Integrate controller with existing orchestrator to coordinate global swaps and mark region state
Add SLO/EB monitoring and automatic rollback hooks into the controller
Create runbook for manual override, abort, and emergency rollback
